reason: NONE. First thing I noticed was 'Every batch lab-tested' with a QR on the box, and anyone can print that; I look for NSF or USP, and a brand with zero reviews doesn't get my money over the three brands I already tried. objection: No third-party seal like NSF or USP, no reviews yet, and I can't tell how big the capsules are. A QR to the brand's own report is still the brand telling me it's fine.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP certification, or a few hundred honest reviews that say the capsules are easy to swallow.
